frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PROVISIONS CONTAINED IN THE POLICE FORCES AMALGAMATION ACT, 1925, IN RELATION TO THE DUBLIN POLICE RATE AND IN RELATION TO THE FORMATION OF REPRESENTATIVE BODIES OF MEMBERS OF THE AMALGAMATED POLICE FORCE ESTABLISHED BY THAT ACT. [11th March, 1926.]

sect.p: 1.In this Act the expression the Principal Act means the Police Forces Amalgamation Act, 1925 (No. 7 of 1925), and the expression the amalgamated force has the same meaning as it has in the Principal Act.
